summary: Learn to sponsor DMAIC projects, review tollgates and sustain process gains. Explore the five-day Six Sigma leadership course.
lede: Six Sigma project leadership helps sponsors select improvement work, set scope and guide decisions across DMAIC stages. For operational leaders, project sponsors and improvement leads, it develops skills in prioritizing projects, linking customer needs to critical-to-quality measures, checking evidence at tollgates and assigning control-plan ownership to sustain process gains.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who sponsor, govern or coordinate Six Sigma improvement work and need a practical foundation in project oversight.
prerequisites: No prior Six Sigma training is required. Familiarity with a process in your work area will help you apply the charter, SIPOC and control-plan exercises.
